results.title: K-State knocks off Creighton behind potent offense
results.description: Kansas State men’s basketball used a dominant night of offense to fly by Creighton at Bramlage Coliseum, earning Casey Alexander his first statement win with an 89-82 victory Tuesday night.

results.title: Paul Vows Retirement Should Doumbé Hand Him Loss
results.description: Jake Paul says he will retire from boxing if he loses to Cédric Doumbé when the two meet December 24th in Dubai. Paul and Doumbé appeared at an opening press conference for their Christmas Eve clash, where Paul dismissed the former kickboxing world champion as nothing more than preparation for bigger fights down the line.
